title: GPT-6 Astra Is Here-Who Controls AI Agents Now?
description:
AI assistants are starting to look less like chatbots-and more like systems that can operate software, coordinate work, stay active, and touch real infrastructure.

This week, GPT-6 Astra pushed computer use forward. Nvidia made a $12.93 billion bet on Hugging Face. Anthropic and Google intensified the race to make long-running agents cheaper. New safety reporting put permissions, monitoring, shutdowns, and audit trails in the spotlight. And the physical AI buildout started looking more like energy and telecom than ordinary software.

The weekly signal: the model is no longer the whole product. The operating system around the agent may soon matter just as much.

Which real job would you trust an AI agent to run-and what would you never let it touch without approval? Tell us below.
